description:
.NET MAUI bindings for the native eSewa payment SDKs on Android and iOS.
      Exposes a single cross-platform API — CrossEsewaPayment.Current.PayAsync(...) —
      that launches the native eSewa checkout and returns a normalized result.
releaseNotes: Initial release: Android (AAR binding) and iOS (Swift xcframework via @objc shim) support.
title: esewa_maui — eSewa payments for .NET MAUI
